system.description:
Consolidates the Improviser, Military Engineer, Outlaw, and Saboteur prestige classes. Grants access to the Improviser, Military Engineer, Misfortune, Outlaw, Outlaw Tech, Procurement, Sabotage, Slicer, and Turret talent trees.

At 1st level, chooses one of Destructive, Field-Created Weapon, Fugitive, or No Tools Required as a free class ability. The others may be taken as talents.
